pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Same 15 kg: 7 reps is in range, now aim for 8 on every set.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Same 10 kg: 7 reps was just under 8, aim for 8 on every set.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Down to 5 kg on another cable station: 10 kg gave 4 to 7 where 12 are asked. Start with the left arm, it lags.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Up one step: both sets reached 15.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Up one step: every set reached 15.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Down to 3 kg: 5 kg gave 9 where 15 to 20 are asked.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Work at 30 kg on every set: it gave 12 last time, so go for 10 on all sets.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Same 20 kg: 10 on every set, go for 12, then up a step.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Same 20 kg: 12 is the bottom of the range, add a rep or more.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Down to 5 kg: 10 kg gave 6 where 12 are asked. If the shoulder hurts, stop and switch to the face pull.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: 5 kg on a cable station that works: 10 kg gave 5 to 6 where 12 are asked. Start with the left arm.

pullA:curl.coach: Same 5 kg with longer rests: sets fell to 7, 6 and 4, aim for 8 on every set.

legsA:leg-press.coach: Empty sled again: 10 on every set, go for 12, then add the first plates.

legsA:rdl.coach: Same 20 kg on the cable: the first set was 6, aim for 10 on every set.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Same 20 kg: 10 is the bottom of the range, go for 12.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Same 10 kg, slow: 8 reps last time, aim for 12, or use the lightest pin if 12 is not there.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Same 20 kg: 10 is the bottom of the range, go for 12.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Bodyweight again: 10 on both sets, go for 12.

pushB:incline-press.coach: First time: pick a weight you could lift about 10 times and stop at 8.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: Same 15 kg: 7 reps is under this day's 8 to 12, aim for 8.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Down to 4 kg: 5 kg gave 9 where 12 to 20 are asked.

pushB:dips.coach: First time: bodyweight dips, leaning forward. If 8 reps is not there, use the chest press machine.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: First time: pick a weight a bit lighter than your pushdown and aim for 12.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: Light 5 kg: 10 kg gave 5 to 6 where 15 to 20 are asked. Start with the left arm.

pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: First time here: pick a step under your 30 kg Pull A pulldown and aim for 10.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: First time: pick a weight you could row about 12 times and stop at 10.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: First time: pick a dumbbell you could row about 13 times. Start with the left arm and match the right to it.

pullB:face-pull.coach: First time: start light and aim for 17 with a pause at the face. Stop if the shoulder hurts.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: 5 kg: 10 kg gave 5 to 6 where 12 are asked. Start with the left arm.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: First time: pick dumbbells you could curl about 14 times and stop at 12.

cable-lateral.note: The 5 kg setting on that cable machine did not work.

reverse-fly.note: Shoulder pain on the first set.

rdl.note: Done on the cable machine, not the barbell.
